decision: 5 second time penalty. 1 penalty point (total of 3 for the 12 month period).
fact: Car 3 forced Car 27 off the track at the approach to Turn 8.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 b) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. On the approach to Turn 8, the driver of Car 3 moved to the right in the braking area and in doing so forced Car 27 off the track.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
